known_facts_book1: A witch of the Gillikin country (legally only a 'Sorceress' or 'Wizardess') who reared Tip and worked him like a servant.
Trades secrets with a crooked wizard for the Powder of Life and other magic, and uses it to bring Jack Pumpkinhead to life.
Plans to transform Tip into a marble statue for her flower garden; he flees, stealing her Powder of Life.
Is hired by Jinjur to stop the Scarecrow, and throws magical illusions (sunflowers, walls, whirling roads, fire) in the travelers' path.
Disguises Jellia Jamb as herself to fool Glinda; exposed, she becomes in turn a rose, a shadow, a black ant, and a Griffin to escape.
Is run down by the Saw-Horse and captured by Glinda with a golden thread, then made to speak truth by the white pearl.
Confesses that, at the Wizard's bidding, she transformed the infant Princess Ozma into the boy Tip, and undoes the enchantment.
Is to be stripped of her magic after the reveal; the boy promises to provide for her in her old age.

known_relations_book1.Tip: Reared him and meant to make him a statue; years earlier she transformed the infant Ozma into Tip at the Wizard's request. His enchanter and guardian, not his mother.
known_relations_book1.Jinjur: Her ally and Jinjur's chief counsellor during the revolt.
known_relations_book1.Glinda: Her adversary and better, who captures her and forces the confession.
known_relations_book1.Wizard of Oz: Paid her with magic lessons and three secret visits to hide the transformed Ozma.

identity_confusion: Mombi is the Wicked Witch of the West
Mombi is the Wicked Witch of the East
Mombi melts when splashed with water

known_facts_book1: A pretty, discontented Gillikin girl who commands the Army of Revolt, some four hundred girls armed only with knitting-needles.
Leads the revolt because 'the Emerald City has been ruled by men long enough,' and to seize its gems and treasury.
Conquers the Emerald City without bloodshed; the one-man Royal Army flees and the Guardian surrenders his keys.
Proclaims herself Queen, wears the Scarecrow's second-best crown, eats caramels on the throne, and sets the men to housework.
Orders the captured Scarecrow's party destroyed, but her army is stampeded by the field mice hidden in the Scarecrow's straw.
Allies with Mombi as her chief counsellor and is besieged by Glinda's army.
Is captured in her courtyard by Glinda's soldiers, ending the war, and is later released on promise of good behavior after returning the stolen gems.

known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: The ruler she dethrones and whose throne and crown she usurps.
known_relations_book1.Mombi: Her chief counsellor and magical ally against the Scarecrow.
known_relations_book1.Glinda: Her conqueror, who besieges the city and takes her prisoner.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The rightful heir who supplants her; Jinjur is deposed so Ozma can take the throne.

not_in_this_book: Jinjur spills blood conquering the city
